sections.h2: Kings Grant Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 111 residential sales closed in Kings Grant (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $619,000, above the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 8 days to sell, faster than the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Kings Grant sales closed between $550,500 and $705,000, or about $282 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($635,000, 56 sales) was about 3% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($615,000, 55 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Kings Grant
sections.html:
99% of the sales were detached homes and 1% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 2,134 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,920 to 2,600 square feet. 44% of the homes that sold had 4 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1963 and 1981, with a median year built of 1968, so this is mostly older homes.
